title: PackageManifest
description: Schema definition for package or library manifest configuration.

$schema.description: URI pointing to this JSON schema.

icon.description: Path or filename of the icon asset (e.g., SVG, PNG).

types.description: List of file paths containing type definitions.

namespaces.description: List of file paths containing namespace configurations.

blocks.description: List of file paths containing block definitions.

assembly.description: Path to a wasm file which implements blocks and namespaces.
